{{Quote|You are Alfonso Luiz Obota, service number 272-20-136, originally from the Adega System. You graduated fourth in your class from the Merchant Academy, qualified as third officer on a freighter, and resigned to join the Alliance.|[[Jan Ors]], to [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]]|<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>}}
'''Third officer''' was a naval rank present within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. [[Sarin Virgilio]] once held the rank of third officer.<ref name="The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook">''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref>
